entries.title: Reported prices open a four-player core; reject inflated carry evidence
entries.question: Can a cheaper Detroit receiver preserve premium QB exposure, and does current Hall evidence justify committing to Braelon?
entries.why_it_matters: Prices now permit concrete allocation comparisons, but stale labels and incorrect usage can create false confidence in cheap roles.
findings: Reported Week8 prices now available; official export not discovered. FSE's expected slate matches the NFL's 11 Sunday afternoon games but does not certify official eligibility.

One coherent DK model snapshot: Allen22.5/$7700, Williams11.9/$6000, Dak17.9/$6300, StBrown16.2/$8000. Allen/Williams=$13700 and34.4 external projected points; Dak/StBrown=$14300 and34.1. These are two-slot packages, not complete alternatives.

Fresh ESPN and official Jets notebook agree Braelon had17carries/104yards and6catches/30yards; ESPN has7targets. FantasyPros incorrectly says24carries. Its134scrimmageyards agrees, but carry claim rejected.

Official Week7 inactive list confirms Hall missed that game. Jets injury page still displays Miami, so LP/QUESTIONABLE is not new Week8 evidence. No confirmed Week8 Hall return or absence established.
Omar had5targets/5catches/115yards; Garrett3targets/2catches/26yards and Mitchell3targets/0catches. Without routes, this does not prove permanent target redistribution.

Week7 Sunday games remain final. Fresh Jets scoring inputs match the archived review; no material scoring correction established. Week7 freeze114.22 and Week6 freeze145.98 stay provisional, not platform settled.
entries.interpretation: Use Allen/Williams rather than force a same-team stack. At these reported prices the pair is $600 cheaper than Dak/StBrown with nearly equal same-model estimates. Add Irving conditionally and investigate Omar at $4,800. Leave Braelon unresolved until Week8 evidence, not stale Week7 practice.
alternatives: Dak/Williams saves another $1,400 versus Allen/Williams while giving up4.6 external projected points; may fund the five remaining slots.
StBrown remains a strong role candidate; paying $2,000 more for him needs a complete funding comparison.
Omar's five targets are less secure than his115yards suggest; Wilson/Mitchell competition could change the forward allocation.
uncertainty: Official DraftKings game-set identity, selected IDs and eligible pool; five remaining priced selections.
Fresh Week8 practice/availability, including Hall and QB conditions.
Omar's forward participation and Detroit distribution; no routes inspected.
